learned_patterns.pattern: The Signal Engine has produced no matrix since 2026-06-30 — a ~20-day outage, not an isolated missed cron. SAFE MODE has been continuously in force, so no signal-based entry has been possible across every session in that window. Position management (the 07-07 INTC stop-out) still executes without the engine, but the prediction stack is dark until signal_engine.yml is restored. This is the single highest-priority operational failure.

For the second time an agentic fill surfaced only via §3 reconciliation — the 07-07 INTC stop-sell was executed by a session that never wrote memory (after the 06-30 JEPQ buy did the same). Broker state is the source of truth (§5.1); always reconcile positions AND recent orders and fold in untracked fills. A stop-out is folded in as a realized exit; a DRIP buy is never undone.

INTC's wide -12.6% ATR stop (anti-whipsaw, sized to a 7.6% ATR) let a -14.98% realized loss through when the name broke down from ~$139 to a $109 fill over five sessions. Wide ATR stops protect against noise but cap little on a genuine trend reversal — consistent with the §3 high-failure-risk override that tightens to 7% when a breakdown is likely.

SOXX fell -12.5% from entry yet was held without a stop (correctly, §13). As the CORE semis sleeve the decline is a DCA/reinvestment opportunity, not an exit — no emergency session, no forced sale. The ETF-tier no-stop rule is working exactly as designed even through a double-digit sector drawdown.

The baseline LAB record vs QQQ is 1 win / 3 loss (25%): ARKK beat QQQ by +5.56%; MRVL, INTC, NVDA lagged. All four are pre-engine (no signal conditions), so they neither validate nor indict the §4.1 gate and cannot form a DO_NOT_TRADE bucket. The learning loop cannot start until the engine produces signal-conditioned entries.
